name: VRScreenCap
summary: OpenXR-based VR bridge bundled with Geo-11. Creates a virtual 3D cinema screen inside a VR headset and displays Geo-11's stereo output on it. Launched via VRScreenCap.cmd included with Geo-11. Uses minimalistic rendering for potentially better performance than Katanga, but without motion controller support. The OpenXR counterpart to Katanga's SteamVR approach.
compatibility_notes: Bundled with Geo-11 — no separate install required. Requires an OpenXR runtime (SteamVR, Oculus, or native headset OpenXR). Motion controller support not available — use Katanga if you need controllers. Works with any OpenXR-compatible PCVR headset.
